repository_receipt.note: The preregistration and all launch materials must be committed before any of the three new trainers starts. The execution receipt must record that commit, even if the remote worktree later contains unrelated changes.

frozen_population.role: development decision surface; noisy mapped labels, not engine truth
frozen_population.support_policy: Use all and only the listed whole streams, in listed order, with the same active-target mask for every run. Any support mismatch invalidates the comparison until corrected.
frozen_population.checkpoint_policy: final weights at the fixed one-pass endpoint only
frozen_population.probability_policy: raw state sigmoid probabilities; no fitted calibration
frozen_population.threshold_policy: probability >= 0.5 for fixed state and state-transition metrics
frozen_population.event_policy: derive onset and release transitions separately within each stream; one-to-one match within stream; combine onset and release counts per key before macro averaging; never match across a stream boundary

matched_gru.role: contextual recipe-matched GRU reference; not a candidate selected by this study

weighted_tcn_lr3e4.role: Track 2 recipe-matched architecture headline and LR-sensitivity reference

event_head_tcn_direct.role: Track 3 direct state output; comparison with the natural control estimates the effect of event-head gradients after config equivalence is verified

natural_tcn_control.role: natural-prevalence BCE, no event heads, no latch; loss-only control

context_outputs_disclosed_but_excluded_f.reason: It answers the already-reported within-checkpoint decoder question, not either new control question.
Calibration preserves AP and changes the operating point; the primary comparison is deliberately raw and fixed at 0.5.

multiplicity.policy: Report every candidate and every preregistered metric. Do not relabel the best of the two LR variants as a matched headline, and do not hide the losing LR probe. No p-values or confidence claims are adjusted or inferred from this single-seed screen.

common: training cohort, streams, target support, feature inputs, architecture, batch, optimizer family, weight decay, LR schedule, and one-pass final step match the intended contrast
final checkpoint exists at the expected fixed endpoint
final prediction arrays are finite and aligned to exactly 269352 rows on the eight frozen streams
no intermediate or selected checkpoint substitutes for final weights
no y4n threshold or calibration parameter is fitted for a primary metric
no B1 output for a new run exists before the immutable y4n decision receipt
validity_gates.natural_control_specific: The natural control must differ from weighted_tcn_lr3e4 only in class_balance=false and transition_weight=1.0 plus descriptive metadata; it must have no event head and no latch.
validity_gates.lr_specific: Each LR variant must differ from weighted_tcn_lr3e4 only in learning_rate plus descriptive metadata.
validity_gates.failure_policy: A failed or invalid run is reported as failed with the gate and cause. It is not silently rerun under a changed recipe; any rerun retains both receipts and is a deviation.

state_objective.interpretation: Isolates natural-prevalence state BCE versus class-balanced, transition-weighted state loss after the config-difference gate passes.

event_head_shared_trunk_gradients.interpretation: Isolates adding the onset/release heads and their shared-trunk gradients; the direct state output is used, never the latch, after the config-difference gate passes.

lr_sensitivity.interpretation: Tests whether the aligned TCN result is sensitive to its optimizer recipe. It does not replace the 3e-4 recipe-matched architecture headline.

material_macro_ap_effect.stream_metric: per-stream macro AP on the frozen stream
material_macro_ap_effect.rule: Both conditions must hold in the claimed direction. Otherwise call the contrast inconclusive at the preregistered effect size.

lr_recipe_sensitivity.rule: Recipe sensitivity is present if either LR candidate gains at least 0.005 aggregate macro AP over 3e-4 and has a strictly positive per-stream macro-AP delta on at least five of eight streams.
lr_recipe_sensitivity.if_neither_passes: No material LR sensitivity was detected at the tested rates and effect threshold.
lr_recipe_sensitivity.if_one_or_both_pass: Report every candidate and label the result optimizer-recipe-sensitive. A candidate is not promoted from this single-seed sensitivity screen.

event_regression_guards.reference: the right-hand/reference run for each contrast
event_regression_guards.rule: Report both deltas for every contrast. If either falls below its floor, label any AP improvement as accompanied by a fixed event-timing regression. The guard does not turn a non-AP result into a win.

objective_and_event_head_effects.rule: Use the same 0.005 aggregate macro-AP and five-of-eight stream rule to call either causal contrast materially positive or negative. Always report fixed state and event metrics beside the ranking result; event-guard failure qualifies the conclusion.

gru_crossing.rule: If an LR variant exceeds the existing GRU on any metric, describe it only as a recipe-sensitive TCN result. It is not a matched architecture win because the GRU did not receive the same LR sweep. A matched claim requires a new preregistered per-architecture recipe comparison.

single_seed.rule: No model or architecture is promoted from these seed-0 runs. A promotion claim requires a separately frozen confirmation across additional seeds or an untouched evaluation.

b1_embargo.existing_results_note: B1 results for the older GRU, Track 2, and Track 3 had already been consulted and cannot be made untouched retroactively. They are not inputs to this three-run decision.
b1_embargo.before_y4n_decision: Do not run, read, generate, or admit B1 inference or metrics for any of the three new runs.
b1_embargo.release_condition: The complete y4n decision JSON is written, SHA-256 hashed, committed, and records every valid/failed run and preregistered decision field.
b1_embargo.after_release: Score B1 final weights for every valid new run, not only a favorable y4n variant. B1 remains development-only, cannot change the frozen y4n decision, and cannot promote a single-seed model.
